title: Targeting the TRIM28-EZH2 Protein-Protein Interface With Cysteine-Reactive Covalent Inhibitors: A Computational Blueprint for Cancer Therapy.
authors: Kehinde, Ibrahim Oluwatobi; Mzozoyana, Vuyisa; Zamisa, Sizwe J; Faya, Mbuso; Soliman, Mahmoud E S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRIM28-EZH2蛋白-蛋白互作界面的共价抑制剂设计，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Aberrant protein-protein interactions (PPIs) play crucial roles in cancer progression by driving transcriptional repression and epigenetic silencing. Among these, the TRIM28-EZH2 interaction is central to maintaining repressive chromatin states that promote tumorigenesis. In this study, we modeled the TRIM28-EZH2 complex using protein-protein docking, revealing a stable interface dominated by the RBCC domain of TRIM28 and the PRC2 catalytic domain of EZH2. A cysteine-focused covalent inhibitor library was screened to identify small molecules capable of targeting reactive cysteines at the interface. Four lead compounds were identified, with compound C87 exhibiting the most favorable binding free energy (DeltaG(bind) = -57.2 kcal/mol) and stable interactions throughout molecular dynamics simulations. These findings highlight the potential of covalent inhibition as a novel strategy to disrupt oncogenic TRIM28-EZH2 complexes and restore tumor suppressor gene expression.
abstract_zh: 异常的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）在癌症进展中通过驱动转录抑制和表观遗传沉默发挥关键作用。其中，TRIM28-EZH2相互作用对于维持促进肿瘤发生的抑制性染色质状态至关重要。在本研究中，我们利用蛋白质-蛋白质对接模拟了TRIM28-EZH2复合物，揭示了一个以TRIM28的RBCC结构域和EZH2的PRC2催化结构域为主的稳定界面。我们筛选了一个以半胱氨酸为靶点的共价抑制剂库，以识别能够靶向界面处反应性半胱氨酸的小分子。鉴定出四种先导化合物，其中化合物C87表现出最有利的结合自由能（DeltaG(bind) = -57.2 kcal/mol），并在分子动力学模拟中保持稳定相互作用。这些发现强调了共价抑制作为一种新策略的潜力，用于破坏致癌性TRIM28-EZH2复合物并恢复肿瘤抑制基因的表达。
